White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV).category: Viral (WSSV in Penaeid Shrimp - Litopenaeus vannamei)
White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV).pesticide: Virkon Aquatic (Potassium Peroxymonosulfate 50%) + Aqua-C 50% (Coated Vit C)
White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV).medicine_name: Virkon Aquatic Disinfectant & Aqua-C 50% Immune Booster
White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV).dosage: 1.5 ppm pond water disinfection (1.5 kg / Acre-meter water); 5g Coated Vitamin C / kg feed top-dressed with squid oil binder twice daily.
White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV).administration_method: Dissolve in 50L pond water and broadcast across aerator currents; top-dress feed for 10 days.
White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV).organic: Fresh Garlic Juice (20 ml/kg feed) + Curcumin Turmeric extract (10g/kg) + Bhuiamla (Phyllanthus niruri 10g/kg) with 20 kg Jaggery/Acre.
White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV).organic_name: Garlic-Curcumin Extract & Phyllanthus niruri Antiviral Feed Binder
White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV).precaution: Strict quarantine: Stop all pond water inlet exchange. Disinfect pond effluent with 10 ppm bleaching powder before any discharge.
White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV).emergency_first_aid: Run all paddlewheel aerators 24/7 to maintain DO > 6.0 mg/L. If biomass is marketable (> 15g), undertake emergency harvest.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 1: Surface Swimming & Lethargy at Pond Dikes
exemplar_images.hallmark: Shrimp aggregating sluggishly near edges of pond embankments with empty gut.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 2: Discrete White Spots on Carapace & Cuticle
exemplar_images.hallmark: 0.5–2.0 mm circular white calcified spots embedded inside head carapace and abdominal segments.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 3: Reddish Body Discoloration & Mass Mortality
exemplar_images.hallmark: Total pinkish-red chromatophore expansion across tail, loose shell, and rapid mortality.

EHP (Microsporidiosis).medicine_name: Sanocare Micro-Clean Aqua & Bacillus Spore Probiotic
EHP (Microsporidiosis).dosage: 5g Sanocare / kg feed with binder for 7 days + 1kg Pond Probiotic / Acre every 5 days.
EHP (Microsporidiosis).administration_method: Pellet feed top-dressing using egg-albumin binder; broadcast probiotic with morning aerators.
EHP (Microsporidiosis).organic: Fermented Rice Bran (FRB) + Bitter Gourd juice (15 ml/kg) + Turmeric (10g/kg) to suppress spore germination.
EHP (Microsporidiosis).organic_name: Fermented Rice Bran (FRB) & Bitter Melon Spore Suppressor
EHP (Microsporidiosis).precaution: Maintain water alkalinity > 130 ppm; perform thorough pond bottom chain dragging to oxidize spores.
EHP (Microsporidiosis).emergency_first_aid: Apply Agricultural Quicklime (CaO 100 kg/Acre) during preparation; increase feed check-tray inspection frequency.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 1: Severe Growth Stunting & Size Variation
exemplar_images.hallmark: Wide variation in body length (5g to 18g in same crop day), persistent slow growth.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 2: Pale Atrophied Hepatopancreas
exemplar_images.hallmark: Shrunk, pale yellowish hepatopancreas under cephalothorax, white gut syndrome.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 3: White Feces Syndrome & Shell Softness
exemplar_images.hallmark: Floating white fecal strands on water surface and chronically soft, papery exoskeleton.

Running Mortality Syndrome (RMS).dosage: 1 Liter BKC 80% per Acre-meter water column at 9 AM + 3g OTC / kg feed for 5 days.
Running Mortality Syndrome (RMS).administration_method: Water column sanitization followed by gut probiotic re-inoculation after 48h.
Running Mortality Syndrome (RMS).organic: Fermented Sugarcane Molasses (30 kg/Acre) + Yeast (500g) + Sea Salt (200 kg/Acre) to stabilize carbon-nitrogen ratio.
Running Mortality Syndrome (RMS).precaution: Never apply BKC during cloudy or rainy weather. Test dissolved oxygen before application.
Running Mortality Syndrome (RMS).emergency_first_aid: Cut daily feed by 50% immediately; run central pit drain to remove toxic anaerobic bottom sludge.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 1: Sluggish Crawling on Bottom Pond Edge
exemplar_images.hallmark: Continuous low-level daily mortality (10-50 dead shrimp/day) in check trays.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 2: Opaque Whitish Muscle Necrosis
exemplar_images.hallmark: Milky cloudy tail muscle, empty digestive tract, and brownish gill soiling.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 3: Flaccid Exoskeleton & Black Gills
exemplar_images.hallmark: Melanized black necrotic gill filaments and complete loss of pleopod reflexes.

Epizootic Ulcerative Syndrome (EUS).category: Fungal / Oomycete (Aphanomyces invadans in Freshwater Carps & Catfish)
Epizootic Ulcerative Syndrome (EUS).dosage: 1 Liter CIFAX per Acre-meter water column diluted in 100L water OR 2.5 ppm KMNO4 water bath.
Epizootic Ulcerative Syndrome (EUS).administration_method: Uniform surface spray across water column on sunny mornings.
Epizootic Ulcerative Syndrome (EUS).organic: Agricultural Quicklime CaO (100 kg/Acre) + Raw Rock Salt (150 kg/Acre) + Turmeric powder (5 kg/Acre).
Epizootic Ulcerative Syndrome (EUS).organic_name: Quicklime & Halite Rock Salt Antifungal Alkalizer
Epizootic Ulcerative Syndrome (EUS).precaution: Occurs commonly during winter pre-monsoon temperature drops (< 22°C). Maintain water depth > 1.5m.
Epizootic Ulcerative Syndrome (EUS).emergency_first_aid: Apply Lime (CaO 100 kg/Acre) to raise water pH > 7.8; broadcast Common Salt (100 kg/Acre) to reduce osmotic stress.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 1: Pin-Head Red Hemorrhagic Spots on Skin
exemplar_images.hallmark: Small focal red petechial spots on fish body flanks, head, and caudal peduncle.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 2: Deep Necrotic Ulcers & Sloughing Scales
exemplar_images.hallmark: Large open circular erosive red ulcers exposing underlying muscle tissues.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 3: Deep Crater Ulcers & Fungal Granuloma
exemplar_images.hallmark: Severe deep crater wounds with fungal hyphae penetrating into spinal column.

Columnaris (Cotton Wool Disease).dosage: 1 Liter BKC 50% / Acre-meter water + 50 mg Terramycin / kg fish biomass in floating pellets for 7 days.
Columnaris (Cotton Wool Disease).administration_method: Water column sanitization and medicated feed top-dressing.
Columnaris (Cotton Wool Disease).organic: De-oiled Neem Cake slurry (100 kg/Acre) + Raw Rock Salt (150 kg/Acre) + Turmeric (5 kg/Acre).
Columnaris (Cotton Wool Disease).organic_name: Neem Cake & Turmeric Slurry Organic Antiseptic
Columnaris (Cotton Wool Disease).precaution: Dilute BKC in 50 Liters pond water before broadcasting. Apply only on bright sunny mornings.
Columnaris (Cotton Wool Disease).emergency_first_aid: Perform dip treatment of severely affected fish in 2 ppm KMNO4 for 1 minute; flush 20% bottom water.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 1: Whitish Saddleback Patch on Dorsal Fin
exemplar_images.hallmark: Pale bleached white band around dorsal fin, eroded fin margins, fin rot.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 2: Cottony Bacterial Tufts on Mouth & Gills
exemplar_images.hallmark: Fluffy yellowish-brown bacterial mats around lips, gills, and operculum.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 3: Severe Gill Rot & Truncated Opercular Margin
exemplar_images.hallmark: Completely rotted brownish gill filaments, respiratory asphyxiation at surface.

Dropsy (Aeromonas).dosage: 5 ml Enrofloxacin Aqua / kg feed + 25 kg Epsom Salt / Acre-meter water column.
Dropsy (Aeromonas).administration_method: Medicated feed drench twice daily; Epsom salt broadcast for osmotic relief.
Dropsy (Aeromonas).organic: Crushed Garlic Paste (25g/kg feed) + Ginger (10g/kg) + Phyllanthus emblica (Amla powder 10g/kg).
Dropsy (Aeromonas).organic_name: Garlic-Ginger Paste & Amla Antioxidant Immune Booster
Dropsy (Aeromonas).precaution: Improve pond bottom hygiene. High stocking density and accumulated unconsumed feed trigger outbreaks.
Dropsy (Aeromonas).emergency_first_aid: Immediately stop overfeeding; siphon out excess organic sludge and apply Zeolite 50 kg/Acre.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 1: Abdominal Swelling (Fluid Retention / Ascites)
exemplar_images.hallmark: Bloated rounded abdomen, lethargic swimming, loss of equilibrium.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 2: Pinecone Spiky Scales & Exophthalmia (Pop-Eye)
exemplar_images.hallmark: Scales standing out like a pinecone due to skin edema, bulging eyes.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 3: Hemorrhagic Vent & Internal Organ Failure
exemplar_images.hallmark: Protruded reddish vent with bloody discharge, complete kidney & liver failure.

Healthy Fish & Shrimp.medicine_name: Pro-Aqua Eco-Shield Water Probiotics & Nutri-Gro Aqua Tonic
Healthy Fish & Shrimp.dosage: 500g Water Probiotics / Acre every 7 days + 10g Mineral Mixture / kg feed.
Healthy Fish & Shrimp.administration_method: Morning broadcast with aerators running; daily feed top-dressing.
Healthy Fish & Shrimp.organic: Fermented Rice Bran (FRB) 25 kg / Acre-meter water + periodic Agricultural Dolomite (50 kg/Acre).
Healthy Fish & Shrimp.organic_name: Fermented Rice Bran (FRB) & Dolomite Buffer Biofloc
Healthy Fish & Shrimp.precaution: Daily monitoring of Dissolved Oxygen (DO > 5.0 mg/L), pH (7.5 - 8.3), and TAN (< 0.1 mg/L).
Healthy Fish & Shrimp.emergency_first_aid: Maintain regular feeding schedules based strictly on check-tray consumption.

exemplar_images.title: Exemplar 1: Glossy Intact Exoskeleton & Clear Rostrum
exemplar_images.hallmark: Translucent cuticle, full dark continuous gut line, intact uropods and antennae.

exemplar_images.title: Exemplar 2: Vigorous Schooling & Feeding Reflex
exemplar_images.hallmark: Aggressive feeding response at check-trays, smooth clean scales, bright red gills.

exemplar_images.title: Exemplar 3: Planktonic Equilibrium & Clean Water Column
exemplar_images.hallmark: Light greenish-brown diatom bloom (Secchi disc 30-35cm), zero ammonia smell.
